            # Format: "Song Title by Artist1, Artist2"
            # We'll split on " by " to get title and artists
            if ' by ' in song_desc:
                title, artists_str = song_desc.split(' by ', 1)
                artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
                suggestions.append(('add', title.strip(), artists))
        elif line.startswith('remove => '):
            song_desc = line[len('remove => '):]
            if ' by ' in song_desc:
